From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From ri- +‎ lasciare. For the sense “relax,” likely a semantic loan from Latin relaxō.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ri.laʃˈʃa.re/
  • Rhymes: -are
  • Hyphenation: ri‧la‧scià‧re

Verb

[edit]

rilasciàre (first-person singular present rilàscio, first-person singular past historic rilasciài, past participle rilasciàto, auxiliary avére)

  1. to issue (a document)
  2. to give (an interview)
  3. to release (a prisoner)
  4. to relax (a muscle, etc.)
